## Runs 6–7 — raw SdH spots and fan design (plan step 3)

Run 6 (nominal n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, working D=0) completed 921 points in 120.36 min; run 7 (n=-1.2e12) completed 486 in 95.68 min. Signed R ranges are -32.95 to 529.63 ohm and -0.38 to 586.87 ohm; measured drain current remains 9.809–9.935 nA, sample temperature 1.165–1.292 K and absolute gate current below 0.216 nA. Small negative voltages are retained, not rectified before FFT. Both spectra contain oscillations, advancing the campaign to a fan; neither scan identifies stacking alone.

The plots below put raw R and current before window-dependent FFTs. Electron features at approximately 7, 14, 22 and 30 T can include harmonics; the ~30 T feature alone cannot identify a Fermi surface, particularly with run 5's second CNP ridge. The hole trace has features near 6.7 and 12.3 T. The onset helper's electron 0.30 T result is censored and unreliable as a measured onset: the low-field grid is coarse and background residuals contribute. Spectral resolution in the 1.5–10 T window is about 1.76 T (zero padding does not improve it). Earlier measure-cell model frequencies/masses were hypotheses, not independently validated here.

**Decision — plan step 4:** map both signs at working D=0, keeping physical gate coordinates authoritative until LL branches provide an independent lever-arm check. Fit branch origins and harmonic relationships across density; do not turn multiple peaks into multiple stacking domains. Only the B_1–B_2 contact pair is observed. The density axis remains geometry-scaled and the D zero is a resistance-symmetry convention.

import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7))
for j, rid in enumerate([6, 7]):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    ch = resolve_channels(r.meta); ci = current_channel(ch)
    cv = next(c for c in ch if c.cid == 'sr1')
    I = r.col(ci.col) / ci.gain; V = r.col(cv.col) / cv.gain
    R = V / I; B = r.col('magnet_field')
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    ax[j, 0].plot(B, R, lw=.7); ax[j, 0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='signed V/I (ohm)', title=f'Raw run {rid}: B_1 - B_2')
    ax[j, 1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), I*1e9, label='drain nA')
    ax[j, 1].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='I (nA)', title='Measured drain current')
    print(f'RUN {rid}: {r.rows} points, interrupted={r.interrupted}, wall={(r.meta["end_time"]-r.meta["start_time"])/60:.2f} min, R range {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm, I range {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
    for name in ['T_sample', 'k_2400_tg_curr', 'k_2400_bg_curr']:
        x=r.col(name); print(name, 'range', x.min(), x.max(), 'median',np.median(x))
    print('columns',r.cols)
    for lo in [1., 1.5, 2.]:
        f, p = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(lo,10), nfft=4096, log=False)
        peaks,_=find_peaks(p[0]); peaks=sorted([k for k in peaks if 3<f[k]<65], key=lambda k:-p[0,k])[:5]
        print('FFT',lo,'..10 T peaks:',[(round(f[k],2),round(p[0,k],1)) for k in peaks], 'Rayleigh',1/(1/lo-.1))
        ax[j,2].plot(f,p[0]/p[0].max(),label=f'{lo}-10 T')
    ax[j,2].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='frequency (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT',title='Signed R, degree-5 B background'); ax[j,2].legend()
    try:
        onset=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
        print(onset.summary())
    except Exception as e: print('ONSET failed:',e)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('hera_scratch/spot_review.png',dpi=140)
plt.show()

for rid in [5,6,7]:
    r=open_run(f'data/{rid}'); dt=np.diff(r.col('time'))
    print('TIMING',rid,'wall s',r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'],'dt percentiles',np.percentile(dt,[10,50,90,99]))
    if rid==5:
        print('delays',r.meta.get('fast_delay'),r.meta.get('slow_delay'),'NPLC',r.meta['instruments']['k_2400_tg']['parameters'].get('nplci', 'not snapshotted; state0=1'))

## HERA — Landau fan across both carrier signs (plan step 4)

> **05:23** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: B 0 to 10 T, 83 rows x 111 gate pairs; nominal n -1.2 to +3.2e12 cm^-2, working D=0, Si=0, base T, dwell 3 s · **ETA ~16:23** (≈11h)

Runs 6–7 show oscillations on the live B_1–B_2 pair without clipping (R maxima 530/587 ohm, drain 9.81–9.94 nA); run 5 finds two CNP ridges, so single-density tones cannot distinguish harmonics, band families and shifted density patches. This fan follows both ridges and both carrier signs at **working D=0**, using run 5's gate-capacitance ratio and offsets; the absolute density scale remains geometry-anchored and the D zero is a resistance-symmetry convention. Look for branch origins, density-dependent frequencies and crossing patterns before assigning stacking or calibrating a lever arm; the hardwired pair does not independently resolve two spatial regions.

Grid: one 0 T baseline row, one 0.75 T diagnostic row, then 81 rows uniform in 1/B from 1.5 to 10 T; every row co-sweeps TG/BG at nominal n=-1.20..+3.20e12 cm^-2 in .04e12 steps (111 points). Physical endpoints TG=-0.277033..+0.983594 V and BG=-0.465040..+1.166281 V stay inside the unchanged validators; Si=0, base sample T, drive 10 nA. At 1.5 T, fourfold filling spacing is nominally .145e12 (~3.6 gate samples); Δ(1/B)=.007083 T^-1 gives ~4.3 samples/cycle at 33 T and Nyquist 70.6 T. Fourier resolution over 1.5–10 T is ~1.76 T. Coverage trade: excludes the narrow TG-limit edges and dense low-B mapping below 1.5 T; the hole density ceiling is imposed by the operating box and cannot be extended. A full 0.3–10 T inverse-field grid at this spacing adds ~374 rows (~40 h); a 0.8..3.2 electron-only line saves ~3 h but loses the hole trajectories and ridge-origin test. High-B spacing reaches .66 T: this first fan does not resolve narrow anticrossings.

Pacing remains operator-set: gate steps 5 mV, Si .5 V/s, τ=.3 s / 24 dB; **3 s fast dwell = 10τ**, with 3 s extra row settle. Set sr1 to 100 uV (nominal 10 kohm full scale) for unknown neutral/high-field peaks; sr0 remains 20 mV. Preconditions print expected vs actual validators, wiring, base temperatures/freshness, heaters off, Si state, drive, lock-in filters and gate pacing before writes. Every followed channel has a live plot; actual field and gate readbacks are recorded. The fixed magnet slew gives **10/(1/7.3)=73 min** bare ramp. Run 5 (NPLC=1) ordinary points took 1.0985 s at 1 s dwell; runs 6/7 imply ~3.1 s field-set overhead beyond the ramp. Budget 3.2 s per new fan point plus flyback/row reads and thermometry checks, with contingency. The first zero-field row costs about 6 min; no separate field retraverse is needed.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first points for current, leakage and clipping, then the first two complete rows; thereafter inspect the watch digest at least every 30 min. At ~3 T check that features form coherent branches before committing the remaining high-field segment. Stop for sustained leakage, clipping, lost current, thermal drift, flat/dead voltage channel or wrong readback; weak oscillation contrast alone requires analysis against runs 6–7, not a stacking conclusion. Per-point automatic guards stop on >1 nA gate current, >=90% X full scale, drain outside 5–12 nA, temperature/readback failure; logfile freshness is checked each row. A safety stop drops E1 to E0 pending explicit re-grant. **VTI caveat:** interrupting a magnet ramp does not stop the supply; the operator must act on the supply if a ramp itself must be stopped. Normal completion holds B=10 T and the electron endpoint for the next decision; no automatic park or safety-surface changes.

# Plan step 4: constant-working-D Landau fan, B_1 - B_2 only.
# Inherited-state reads and safety validation precede every instrument write.
import numpy as np
from scipy.constants import e as _e, epsilon_0 as _eps0
from hera.analysis import field_invB

for _label in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_label, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_label], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _Bstart = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Si = k_si(); _ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print(f'EXPECTED base Ts=1.0..1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K, |B|<0.02 T, Si=0 V, heaters=(0,0), PS/output on; ACTUAL Ts={_Ts}, Tv={_Tv}, B={_Bstart}, Si={_Si}, ranges={_ranges}, PS/output={_ps}/{_out}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts) < .6
assert abs(_Bstart) < .02 and abs(_Si) < .01 and _ranges == (0, 0) and _ps and _out
for _p, _expected in ((k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)), (k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),
                      (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)), (dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                      (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)), (heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                      (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))):
    _actual = (float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(f'SAFETIES {_p.full_name}: expected {_expected}, actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual == _expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10. and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
_expected_wiring = {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                    'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print('EXPECTED hardwired B_1-B_2; ACTUAL', WIRING)
assert WIRING == _expected_wiring
_drive, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
_tau0, _tau1 = sr0.time_constant(), sr1.time_constant()
_slope0, _slope1 = sr0.filter_slope(), sr1.filter_slope()
_nplc = (k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
_steps = (k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step)
_rng, _dc_on = dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output()
print(f'EXPECTED drive 1 V/13.777 Hz, tau .3/.3 s, slope 24/24, NPLC 1/1, gate step .005/.005 V; ACTUAL {_drive}/{_freq}, tau {_tau0}/{_tau1}, slope {_slope0}/{_slope1}, NPLC {_nplc}, steps {_steps}')
print(f'EXPECTED Si RNGE=2, output=1, pacing=.5 V/s; ACTUAL {_rng}, {_dc_on}, {dc205.ramp_rate}')
assert abs(_drive-1.) < 1e-6 and abs(_freq-13.777) < .01
assert (_tau0,_tau1) == (.3,.3) and (_slope0,_slope1) == (24,24)
assert _nplc == (1.,1.) and _steps == (.005,.005)
assert _rng == 2 and _dc_on == 1 and abs(dc205.ramp_rate-.5) < 1e-9
assert sr0.sensitivity() == .02
assert meas_config['sr0_gain'] == -1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor'] == 100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel'] == 'sr1'

# Run 5 ratio/offsets; absolute scale is geometry-anchored, D zero is a working symmetry convention.
FAN_CAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_nom = np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,111)  # display units: 1e12 cm^-2
_q = _e*(n_nom-FAN_CAL['n_offset'])*1e16
_d = 2*_eps0*(0.-FAN_CAL['D_offset'])*1e9
Vt_fan = (_q+_d)/(2*FAN_CAL['c_tg'])
Vb_fan = (_q-_d)/(2*FAN_CAL['c_bg'])
B_fan = np.r_[0., .75, field_invB(1.5,10.,81)]
for _p,_vec in ((k_tg.volt,Vt_fan),(k_bg.volt,Vb_fan),(magnet.field,B_fan)):
    for _v in _vec: _p.validate(float(_v))
print(f'GRID {len(B_fan)} B rows x {len(n_nom)} gate pairs; TG {Vt_fan[0]:+.6f}..{Vt_fan[-1]:+.6f} V, BG {Vb_fan[0]:+.6f}..{Vb_fan[-1]:+.6f} V')
print('RAMP: 0->10 T at 1/7.3 T/min = 73 min bare; estimated total 11 h incl dwell, flybacks, reads, contingency')

sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
assert sr1.sensitivity() == 100e-6
mc_fan = dict(meas_config)
mc_fan.update({'sr1_gain':1., 'Si (V)':_Si, 'sample_temperature:':_Ts,
               'fan_calibration':FAN_CAL, 'n_nominal_1e12_cm2':n_nom.tolist(),
               'D_working_V_nm':0., 'absolute_density_scale':'geometry prior; pending LL check',
               'D_zero':'run-5 CNP resistance symmetry; provisional',
               'lockin_tau_s':[_tau0,_tau1], 'lockin_slope_dB':[_slope0,_slope1],
               'gate_nplci':list(_nplc), 'comments':'landau-fan: B_1-B_2, B 0/.75/1.5..10 T, 83x111, nominal n -1.2..3.2e12 at working D=0, base T, Si=0, 3 s dwell, sr1 100 uV'})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc_fan)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B=[0,0.75]+81 uniform-in-1/B points 1.5->10 T; n_nominal=-1.20..+3.20e12 cm^-2 (111, .04 step), D_working=0 V/nm; TG=-.277033..+.983594 V, BG=-.465040..+1.166281 V; Si=0; 10 nA; base T; fast_delay=3 s; calibration run 5, absolute scale provisional')
# Raw X values stored (gain=1); metadata gains used by hera-watch/analysis.
_fan_follow = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for _p in _fan_follow:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)
s.plot(k_tg.volt,magnet.field,sr1.X)

_guard = {'points':0, 'reason':None}
def fan_guard(station, data):
    # multimegasweep layout: time, B set, TG set, BG set, followed values.
    _v = dict(zip([p.full_name for p in _fan_follow],map(float,data[4:])))
    _reason=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)): _reason.append('nonfinite data')
    if max(abs(_v[k_tg.curr.full_name]),abs(_v[k_bg.curr.full_name])) > 1e-9:
        _reason.append('gate current >1 nA')
    if abs(_v[sr0.X.full_name]) >= .9*.02 or abs(_v[sr1.X.full_name]) >= .9*100e-6:
        _reason.append('lock-in >=90% full scale')
    _Id = _v[sr0.X.full_name]/mc_fan['sr0_gain']
    if not 5e-9 < _Id < 12e-9: _reason.append('drain current outside 5..12 nA')
    if not 1.0 <= _v[T_sample.full_name] <= 1.5: _reason.append('sample T outside base window')
    if not 0 < _v[T_vaporizer.full_name] < 1.6: _reason.append('vaporizer outside base window')
    if abs(_v[magnet.field.full_name]-float(data[1])) > .03: _reason.append('field readback mismatch >30 mT')
    if abs(_v[k_tg.volt.full_name]-float(data[2])) > .003 or abs(_v[k_bg.volt.full_name]-float(data[3])) > .003:
        _reason.append('gate readback mismatch >3 mV')
    if _guard['points'] % len(n_nom) == 0:
        try:
            for _label in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(_label,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_label],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as _exc: _reason.append('thermometry freshness: '+str(_exc))
    _guard['points'] += 1
    if _reason:
        _guard['reason']='; '.join(_reason)
        print('FAN STOP:',_guard['reason'], 'B/TG/BG setpoints',data[1:4])
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard,())
# Existing driver pacing handles initial positioning and every row flyback.
s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(Vt_fan[0])); s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(Vb_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
fan_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[B_fan], [k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[Vt_fan,Vb_fan],
                            slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
print('FAN END:',fan_result.id,'interrupted=',fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted'),'guard=',_guard)
print('ACTUAL B/TG/BG/Si/Ts/Tv:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())
# Hold end state; no automatic return after completion or abort.

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
